article.headline: Ward scores 15 off the bench, VCU downs Saint Peter's 78-61
article.description: — Tyrell Ward helped lead VCU over Saint Peter's on Wednesday with 15 points off of the bench in a 78-61 win.

article.story: RICHMOND, Va. -- — Tyrell Ward helped lead VCU over Saint Peter's on Wednesday with 15 points off of the bench in a 78-61 win. Ward shot 5 for 11 and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Rams (2-1). Terrence Hill Jr. scored 13 points, going 4 of 5 (3 for 4 from 3-point range). Barry Evans had 11 points and went 5 of 7 from the field. Brent Bland finished with 25 points for the Peacocks (1-2). VCU took the lead for good with 13:13 remaining in the first half. The score was 41-32 at halftime, with Ward racking up nine points. Evans scored a team-high nine points after halftime. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
